top_signals.title: Colombia Quake Levels Buildings, Sparks Survivor Search
top_signals.summary: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake shook western Colombia on Monday, reducing buildings to rubble, sending residents into the streets and setting off a desperate search for people trapped under the debris. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Turkish Funds Urge Action as Stock Swings Threaten MSCI Status
top_signals.summary: Turkish investment funds are urging authorities to crack down on unusual trading activity that’s sent some stock prices soaring and has put the nation at risk of exclusion from major equity benchmarks.
